Python 3.10+, PEP 8, `agent-framework==1.0.0rc4`. Learning/experimentation repo for Microsoft Agent Framework; production-quality PM Copilot, docs/examples.

Setup: `python -m venv .venv`; `source .venv/bin/activate`; `pip install -r requirements.txt`; `cp .env.example .env  # then fill in OPENAI_API_KEY at minimum`
Run: `python app.py --console`; `python app.py --server`; `python app.py --devui`; `python app.py --copilotkit`
Server: `POST /api/local_chat`, `POST /api/messages`, `GET /chat`, `/copilotkit`. `GRAPH_MODE=mock` default; `GRAPH_MODE=live` requires Azure credentials.

`cd maf_copilotkit/agent`; `uv venv && source .venv/bin/activate`; `uv pip install -e .`; `uvicorn server:app --reload --port 8000`
`cd maf_copilotkit/web`; `pnpm install && pnpm dev`
`cd tmp-ag-ui`; `pnpm install && pnpm build`; `pnpm test`; `pnpm lint`; `pnpm dev`

Star-topology: Triage routes to 5 specialists (SharePoint, Meetings, Calendar, Documents, Project Info); specialists hand back. Triage (`maf/agents/triage.py`) has no tools, pure reasoning. Orchestration: `maf/orchestration/handoff_workflow.py` (`HandoffBuilder`). Tools: `maf/tools/`, `<REDACTED_USER>(approval_mode="never_require")` decorator, `Annotated` params. Graph client: `maf/tools/graph_client.py`, lazy singleton, mock/live via `GRAPH_MODE`. Config: `maf/config.py`, `pydantic-settings` from `.env`. AG-UI bridge: `maf/agui_endpoint.py`, stateless, fresh workflow/request. Examples: `maf/agents/01_handoff/`–`05_magentic/`.

New tools go in `maf/tools/`, new agents in `maf/agents/`
New agents in the PM Copilot flow must be wired in `maf/orchestration/handoff_workflow.py`
Never commit `.env` files or secrets
Update `ANTIGRAVITY.md` if architectural changes are made
See `ANTIGRAVITY.md` for MAF upgrade procedures
